description: This file defines an Account class with nested AccountType enum used in accounting integration tests within the Fineract project. It models account properties, including type and ID, for testing purposes.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Represents an accounting account with an associated account type and ID within testing scenarios.

classes.name: AccountType
classes.description: Enumerates types of accounts such as Asset, Income, Expense, Liability, and Equity, each with a corresponding string value.

methods.name: Account
methods.description: Constructor initializing account ID and account type.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type of the account instance.

methods.name: getAccountID
methods.description: Returns the account ID of the account instance.
